title: The Mossy Bridge
text: A stone bridge so overgrown it looks like a hill with a hole in it. A sign hangs on it in letters painted with something dark: TOLL. Beneath the arch, a troll the size of a cottage snores, a purse on its belly rising and falling.

options.label: Creep across past the sleeping troll, and do not wake it.

outcomes.text: Across, and the troll snores on. On the far side its toll box sits unattended.
It wakes, and it is very cross about the toll.

options.label: Leave the toll on its belly, as an honest traveller would.

outcomes.text: Honest, and the wood approves, and the path feels lighter.

options.label: The quietest hands lift the troll's purse, as it snores.

outcomes.text: A fat purse of other travelers' tolls, and the troll never stirs.
A troll's grip, and the crunch of something giving way.

options.label: The Knight wakes the troll and pays the toll to its face, as honour demands.

outcomes.text: The troll is so astonished it gives the coin back, and tells everyone it meets about the honest knight.
